messages.text:
"Copy and paste the following prompt into your AI game maker to generate your game design document and mechanics:
​Act as an expert game developer and create a comprehensive Game Design Document (GDD) for a new open-world survival and monster-taming MMORPG inspired by Chimeraland. Flesh out the mechanics, systems, and core gameplay loop based on the following required features:
​World Design and PvPvE Zones
The map is divided into safe outer regions and a highly contested central zone called the Middle Land. The outer lands are strictly PvE and safe zones where players can gather resources, cut down trees, construct intricate custom homes, and tame their first basic monsters. The Middle Land is a permanent PvP zone containing the highest-tier resources, rarest monster spawns, and endgame territory control mechanics.  
​Rank and Absolute Power Scaling
Players, tamed monsters, and wild creatures belong to a strict tier system: E, D, C, B, A, S, SS, and Emperor. Power scaling is rigid: each rank is exactly twice as strong as the preceding rank. For example, an E-Rank player paired with an E-Rank tamed monster will barely be able to defeat a single wild D-Rank monster. Detail the evolution, breeding, and resource requirements necessary to ascend through these ranks.  
​Military Hierarchy and Shop Access
The social structure and economy rely on a rigid military command system tied to daily missions and exclusive vendors.
​Standard players can only purchase items from the regular Player Rank Shop.  
​Players group under a designated Captain for daily missions. Earning the Captain title unlocks the exclusive Captain Shop, offering better gear and taming tools.  
​Captains report to a General, who leads massive PvP pushes into the Middle Land. Generals have access to the General Shop for siege weapons and top-tier assets, alongside access to all lower-tier shops.  
​Expand upon this system by adding an ultimate \"Emperor\" or \"Warlord\" role at the very top. Detail how players get promoted or demoted through these ranks via PvP participation or daily mission performance.
​Please output the core game loop, a detailed breakdown of the monster taming and evolution system, and the territory control mechanics for the Middle Land.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
